name: the release click is not swallowed
why: A drag released outside the panel still produces a click on the page. Without the one-shot swallower it reaches whatever lies under the pointer (a sortable header, a link) while the panel itself looks fine.

edits.find: window.addEventListener('click', swallow, { capture: true, once: true });

grep: a drag released outside the panel

name: the shared panel keeps the previous column's size
why: One element serves every column. Without the reset at the top of the positioning block, a column with no stored size opens at whatever size the last resized column left behind.
grep: the size is remembered for that column only

name: the stored size is applied as content-box
why: The size is stored as the rendered border-box size. Applied as content-box, every reopen grows the panel by its border and padding.

name: the dropdown size is left out of the config export
why: The workspace block is an allowlist; a key missing from _CFG_WORKSPACE_GROUPS is silently neither exported nor accepted on import.
